law_name: Law No. 9 of 1968 Issuing the Copyright Protection Law
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (commonly reported; 50 years from publication for posthumous works, Art. 22) (unconfirmed)
registration_required: Yes (deposit of the work with the Copyright Protection Office within one month of publication (secondary source; unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: Copyright Protection Office, Ministry of Culture (unconfirmed)
notes: Law dated 16 March 1968 (Official Gazette No. 10 of 30/3/1968). Some sources cite Law No. 7 of 1984 as the current law (or as a deposit law); unresolved. Berne since 28 Sep 1976. WCT/WPPT/TRIPS status not found.
